method.sv: Ofullständigt forskningsurval. Varje flyg märks Enligt tidtabell eller Dokumenterat genomförd. Tidtabeller belägger inte att flyget gick. Militär-, charter- och privatflyg kräver egna rörelsehandlingar med tider; datumuppgifter utan klockslag animeras inte. Storcirklar och jämn rörelse är illustrationer, även för dokumenterade flyg. Tiderna använder historiska tidszoner och äldre flygplatslägen används vid behov. Saknad data betyder inte ingen trafik.
method.en: Incomplete research sample. Each flight is marked Scheduled or Documented as operated. Timetables do not establish operation. Military, charter and private flights require their own timed movement records; date-only records are not animated. Great-circle paths and uniform motion are illustrations, including for documented flights. Historical time zones and airport sites are used where needed. Missing data does not mean no traffic.

notes.sv: Utgåva 11 februari–26 april 1986, delvis transkriberad. Urval från Berlin, Europa, Atlantflyg och Västafrika. Senaste omgången kompletterar fysiska delsträckor via Bryssel, Amsterdam och Hamburg. Marsändringar och mellanlandningar granskas separat. Istanbul-raderna är kandidater på grund av en konflikt i den tryckta tidszonen. Tidtabellen belägger inte faktiskt genomförande eller last. Omgång 18 kompletterar Sydamerika, Venezuela, Trinidad och Tobago samt Mexico City med tidsatta fysiska delsträckor. Importen är avgränsad till 26 februari–1 mars; PA217 till 28 februari. Aprils nya nordiska linjer ingår inte. V55: tre Nonstop-rader ger PA67 Warszawa–Frankfurt lördag, PA76 Budapest–Dubrovnik fredag och PA77 Dubrovnik–Budapest lördag. Båda Dubrovnik-radernas No Local Traffic-anmärkning bevaras. Apriländringar används inte i februari/marsfönstret. München–Budapest:s TuWe och Budapest–München:s WeTh utvidgas inte från anslutningsresors veckodagar. Prag i expansionsannonsen gäller från 27 april och importeras inte. V56: PA77 Zagreb–München-Riem fredag 09:30–10:25 och PA76 München-Riem–Zagreb lördag 11:15–12:10 tillkommer från egna Nonstop-rader. Raderna upphör efter 28 respektive 29 mars. Belgrad–München och retur med ett stopp delas inte utan fullständiga mellantider. Zagreb–Frankfurt:s fredagsvariant från 1 april och Bukarest-rader utanför rätt veckodagar importeras inte. V57: PA61 Aten–Frankfurt fredag 09:30–11:25 och PA150 Frankfurt–Aten lördag 12:15–16:00 tillkommer. Båda är Nonstop med No Local Traffic On Above Flight. UTC+2 i Aten och UTC+1 i Frankfurt ger 175 respektive 165 minuter. Raderna upphör efter 28 respektive 29 mars. Söndagsraden PA151 och senare mars-/aprilvarianter importeras inte.
notes.en: Edition 11 February–26 April 1986, partly transcribed. Selected Berlin, European, transatlantic and West African services. The latest batch completes physical legs via Brussels, Amsterdam and Hamburg. March amendments and stopovers are reviewed separately. Istanbul rows remain candidates because of a conflict in the printed time-zone heading. A timetable does not establish actual operation or cargo. Batch 18 adds timed physical segments for South America, Venezuela, Trinidad and Tobago, and Mexico City. Import is limited to 26 February–1 March; PA217 to 28 February. New Nordic services starting in April are excluded. V55: three Nonstop rows yield PA67 Warsaw–Frankfurt Saturday, PA76 Budapest–Dubrovnik Friday and PA77 Dubrovnik–Budapest Saturday. Both Dubrovnik rows retain No Local Traffic restrictions. April changes are not applied to the February/March window. Munich–Budapest TuWe and Budapest–Munich WeTh are not expanded using connecting-itinerary day patterns. Prague in the expansion advertisement is effective27 April and is not imported. V56: PA77 Zagreb–Munich-Riem Friday 09:30–10:25 and PA76 Munich-Riem–Zagreb Saturday 11:15–12:10 added from separate Nonstop rows. The rows are discontinued after 28 and 29 March respectively. One-stop Belgrade–Munich itineraries are not split without complete intermediate timings. The Zagreb–Frankfurt Friday variant effective 1 April and Bucharest rows on other weekdays are not imported. V57: PA61 Athens–Frankfurt Friday 09:30–11:25 and PA150 Frankfurt–Athens Saturday 12:15–16:00 added. Both are Nonstop with No Local Traffic On Above Flight. UTC+2 in Athens and UTC+1 in Frankfurt yield 175 and 165 minutes. Rows end after 28 and 29 March respectively. Sunday PA151 and later March/April variants are excluded.

notes.sv: Tidtabell från 1 februari 1986, delvis visuellt granskad. Importen omfattar Atlantas Europalinjer med retur samt utvalda inrikes nonstopavgångar från Atlanta. Tryckta veckodagar och framtida startdatum är granskade; Orly och Gatwick används. Slutdatum för hela utgåvan är inte fastställt; importerade rader är avgränsade till granskningsperioden 26 februari–1 mars. Tidtabellen visar planerad trafik, inte faktiskt genomförande. V64: ytterligare inrikes nonstopavgångar från Atlanta granskade på tryckta s. 14–18, med teckenförklaring s. 4 och utvalda flygnummer i linjeförteckningen s. 262–264. 123 källrader: 87 nya scheman, 33 tidigare importerade, två rader med otydliga minutangivelser hålls utanför och en rad börjar först 2 mars. 185 nya rörelser till 23 flygplatser. DL137 är fredagsflyg med särskilt giltighetsintervall 28 februari–7 mars; endast 28 februari importeras. DL25 till Honolulu flyger inte måndagar/fredagar. DL790 och DL760 till Detroit kontrollerade i linjeförteckningen. Houston I/H skiljer Intercontinental från Hobby. Returtrafik, fler inrikesorter, anslutningsbolag och ändringsblad återstår. Alla tidigare Delta-rader och rörelser är oförändrade. V65: Atlanta till/från Fort Lauderdale, Fort Myers, Jacksonville, Orlando och West Palm Beach. 72 källrader på tryckta s. 15, 17, 18, 81, 84, 115, 182 och 247; 67 nya nonstop-scheman ger 137 rörelser. Tre genomgående rader med ett stopp, en söndagsvariant och DL158 med start 2 mars hålls utanför. DL94 Orlando–Atlanta har sista trafikdag 1 mars enligt fotnot 14 på s. 183. Flygplatskoder verifierade på s. 260–261. Fem flygplatser tillkommer med granskad historisk identitet. Alla tidigare scheman och rörelser är oförändrade. Anslutningsraden DL106/1658 Atlanta–Bradley via LaGuardia hålls utanför som obruten sträcka. New York-suffix L=LaGuardia och E=Newark läses per rad. Flygplatskoder kontrollerade på s. 260–261. Fem flygplatser tillkommer med granskad historisk identitet. Alla tidigare scheman och rörelser är oförändrade. V67: Returtrafik till Atlanta från Boston, Chicago O’Hare, Dallas/Fort Worth, Detroit, Miami, Philadelphia, Tampa och Washington National. 80 källrader på tryckta s. 31, 46, 64, 73, 150, 191, 229 och 244: 59 nya scheman ger 123 rörelser; 12 befintliga rader matchas utan nyimport, fem genomgående rader och två anslutningar utesluts, två lördagsavgångar ligger efter fönstret. DL138 DFW–ATL flyger lördag, med giltighet 1–8 mars enligt fotnot 5 på s. 65; bara 1 mars importeras. Alla tidigare scheman, flygplatser och rörelser är oförändrade. Köpenhamns tjänster går söndag/måndag och ger inga rörelser i fönstret. Tidtabellen belägger planerad trafik, inte genomförande. Omgång 16 kompletterar med 23 dagliga delsträckor i Stillahavstabellen, kontrollerade mot rutterna på s. 142. Glasgowsträckan rättas till Prestwick enligt s. 43 och 150. Nordiska rörelser är oförändrade. Atlantiska matarsträckor under 840–845 samt Stillahavstabellens återstående rader är inte importerade i denna omgång. Omgång 17 tillför 29 rader i Asien samt till/från Stillahavsområdet. NW27 onsdag Tokyo–Manila och NW28 torsdag Manila–Tokyo undantas enligt 7 januari-fotnoten. Stadskoder OSA/SEL och historiska HKG/KUL mappas till Itami, Kimpo, Kai Tak respektive Subang. Endast rader som ger rörelser i fönstret har lagts till.

notes.en: 55-page PDF advertised as complete by the archive; the entire pagination has not been audited and the source is provisionally treated as partial. Nordic non-stop rows visually reviewed. The VIA arrow means non-stop per page 4; day codes and local times per pages 2–4. Paris B/G means Charles de Gaulle, and Oslo explicitly means Fornebu. Only individually timed legs are imported. Edition 25 applies; subsequent amendments and actual operation are unverified. V25 adds four AFSK/SKAF rows linking Copenhagen with Nice/Lyon. Both codes are retained in the note; the first printed code is used for catalog grouping. Each departure is counted once; the actual operating carrier is undetermined. V28 adds Great Britain services linking Heathrow/Manchester with Paris, Lyon and Nice. December amendments and AFBA919 effective 1 March reviewed. BA-coded rows are grouped under British Airways. AFBA919 counted once under AF; actual operator undetermined. V29 adds EI522/EI523 and AF968/AF969 linking Dublin and Charles de Gaulle in both directions: four schedule rows, six movements. EI523 is valid through 28 March. Other Irish rows on these spreads do not operate Friday/Saturday and are not imported. V30 uses Air Inter no. 52 for IT day-dependent number prefixes. Times and non-stop rows compared for six French Paris links. Ten arrival-time conflicts withheld from animation; no AF movement added. V31 adds 42 non-stop rows with Spanish endpoints, 50 movements. AF/IB double codes counted once under first printed code. Rows without non-stop arrow, including Palma–Paris IB668/669 and Lyon–Madrid, excluded. Page 5 gives a Nice–Monaco frequency but no times; no such movements imported. V32 adds 15 reviewed rows and 15 Portugal movements. V33 adds 22 reviewed rows and 35 Netherlands movements. Amsterdam–Marseille, KLAF306/307 Rotterdam–Paris and AF1910/1911 Nice–Amsterdam lack a non-stop arrow and are not imported as non-stop legs. AFKL/KLAF cooperation services counted once under the first printed airline code. V34 adds 24 reviewed rows and 31 Belgium movements. Brussels–Marseille lacks a non-stop arrow and is not imported as a non-stop leg. AFSN/SNAF cooperation services counted once under the first printed airline code. SNAF639 retains printed 08:01. V35 adds 56 reviewed rows and 89 West Germany movements. Rows effective 1 November used where indicated. Frankfurt–Marseille/Toulouse lack non-stop arrows and are not imported as non-stop legs. Munich remains located at Riem. V36 adds six non-stop rows / nine Tegel–Düsseldorf movements. AF766 does not continue to Tegel on Saturday per pages 32/62; the earlier Paris–Düsseldorf movement is retained. V37 adds 48 non-stop rows / 80 movements between Geneva/Zurich and France. SRAF/AFSR counted once under the first printed code; SR763 row effective 11 February used. V38 adds four non-stop rows / eight Vienna–Paris movements. AF uses CDG, OS uses Orly. Salzburg rows operate on Thursday/Sunday and are excluded from the window. V39 adds 65 non-stop rows / 96 Italy movements. Linate and Pisa identified separately; AZ1351 is split into CDG–Genoa and Genoa–Naples with a 45-minute ground interval. V40 adds two non-stop rows and two Friday movements between Orly and Warsaw/Okęcie. AFLO280/LOAF273 are each counted once; actual operator is not established. V41 adds six non-stop rows and six movements: two Prague–Orly and four Budapest–Orly. The selected Friday AFMA559 row is valid through 28 February. Every combined code is counted once. V42 adds eight non-stop rows and eight movements: three for Otopeni and five for Sofia, including two cargo flights. AF719 and AFLZ706 are through itineraries with intermediate stops on page 10 and are not imported as non-stop. Timed intermediate segments are missing. Combined codes are counted once. V43 adds eight non-stop rows and eight movements: four Belgrade–Orly and four Zagreb–Orly, half AF-coded and half JU-coded. Surčin and Pleso are explicitly named. Both belong to Yugoslavia in the 1986 country classification. V44 adds eleven non-stop rows/movements: ten Athens–France and one CDG–Larnaca. Friday AFOA600/601 are counted once under AF. Saturday AF600/601 and OA201/202 respect row validity. AF164 arrives next day after the window end but still overlaps the window. V45 adds six non-stop rows and eight Istanbul–Paris movements: AF608/609 Friday and Saturday, TK927/928 Friday and TK925/926 Saturday. B=CDG 2B and S=Orly. TK928 arrives next local day but on the same UTC date. Ankara connection rows are not imported as direct flights. V46 adds twelve movements with USSR endpoints, seven grouped under AF and five under SU. AF270 has two legs and a 75-minute Moscow stop. AFSU700 is counted once under AF and goes to Borispol, not Zhulyany. SU251/252 date 31/10 is a start date; applicable Friday AF720/721 variants start 7 February. V50: pages 76 and 88 corroborate times, operating days, airports and nonstop markings for 18 Air Inter rows/20 Paris–Strasbourg movements. Full IT numbers follow the own-edition Air Inter day-colour rule. The comparison creates no extra AF movements. V51: the Barcelona departure spread (printed pages 16–17) is absent from the reviewed PDF; PDF pages 9–10 jump from 14–15 to 18–19. Adjacent spreads and the whole-file page overview checked. No Barcelona return is created from inbound times.

notes.sv: Originalutgåva nr 52, 43 PDF-sidor. Utvalda rader visuellt transkriberade; hela katalogen och sidföljden är inte färdiggranskade. S. 4 kräver prefix 7 för röda dagar, 6 för svarta/vita och 5 för blå. Inramade dagar är biljettvillkor, inte undantag. Julens färgändringar gäller inte importdatumen. W/S=Orly, B/G=Charles de Gaulle enligt s. 5. Endast fredag 28 februari och lördag 1 mars importeras. Tidtabell, inte belagt genomförande. notes.en: Full scan available, but only a targeted Nordic selection imported. Seven Stops 0 rows produce six DA and one SK movement on Friday 28 February. Missing intermediate times are not invented. October system-table Tees-side timings differ from the existing later winter evidence and are not imported in parallel. Timetable, not confirmed operation. V48 extends the reviewed selection with 47 British/Channel Islands rows, 54 movements on 28 February–1 March. DA193 Inverness–Manchester is withheld because of the 11:10/11:15 conflict. Earlier Tees-side conflicts and all previous movements are retained. V49 adds four Irish DA rows/movements on Friday 28 February: DA723/724, DA772 and DA756. Differing EI457 times/days are not imported; EI456 is deferred for later checking. V51: ten new Stops 0 rows yield ten Amsterdam–Bristol and Amsterdam–Tegel movements: eight Friday, two Saturday. Berlin is mapped to Tegel using retrospective route history (https://www.danairremembered.com/1980s.php); the timing heading itself only says Berlin. Tees-side system rows remain withheld where later winter evidence differs in timings/days. The Bristol route’s later closure in 1986 remains a lead without a verified amendment date affecting these February/March dates. V52: eight new Stops 0 rows yield ten movements: Saarbrücken–Tegel in both directions (eight) and Gatwick–Munich-Riem in both directions (two). Six Friday, four Saturday. Berlin is identified as Tegel using retrospective route history (https://www.danairremembered.com/1980s.php). Ensheim receives a marker using its published 2022 reference point solely for airport-site positioning. Later amendments and actual operation are not established. V53: eleven new Stops 0 rows yield thirteen movements on Berne–Gatwick, Zurich–Gatwick and Zurich–Manchester, both directions. Eight Friday, five Saturday. DA852/853 effective from 21 December. DA861’s printed nonstop pattern 1...56. is preserved in the transcription; only Friday/Saturday imported, not the Wednesday implied by a connection row. Bern–Belp identified using Bern Airport 3/2012 page 24. Page 23 coaches are not counted as flights. V54: DA880 Gatwick–Innsbruck 08:00–11:00 and DA881 Innsbruck–Gatwick 11:45–12:45, pages 12 and 10 respectively. Both show Stops 0, .....67 and effective from 15 December. Two Saturday movements added for 1 March. Thursday DA884/885 do not overlap the observation window; connections are not extra nonstop flights. Innsbruck mapped to Kranebitten using official airport history.

notes.sv: Southwest-systemtidtabellen dateras 12 januari 1986 av arkivet. AirTimes listar nästa utgåva 18 mars 1986; inget tryckt slutdatum eller fullständigt ändringsbladsbestånd har verifierats. Tryckta s. 13–16 har granskats visuellt. Röd flygnummertext betyder Southwest; blå Muse Air-rader utesluts. N/S betyder nonstop och 1=måndag till 7=söndag enligt sidfoten. Tider tolkas som lokala klockslag enligt tidtabellskonvention och skillnaden mellan Central och Mountain Time; en separat all-times-local-legend har inte återfunnits. Endast 27 februari–1 mars används som lokala avgångsdatum; intervallöverlapp avgör vilka avgångar som visas. Planerad trafik, inte belagt genomförande, individflygplan eller faktisk flygbana. Blå Muse Air-rader och rader med mellanlandningar/anslutningar utesluts. PHX använder America/Phoenix, UTC−7; El Paso UTC−7 och övriga nya ändpunkter UTC−6 under importdatumen. WN797 och WN717 landar nästa lokala dag; söndagsrader WN956/997 skapar inga rörelser i fönstret. Fortsatt partiell bolagstäckning: övriga nätet, Muse Air, fysiska genomgående tjänstekedjor och ändringsblad återstår. V60: Phoenix s. 44–46 och Las Vegas s. 27–29 har granskats visuellt. 149 röda N/S-källrader transkriberas: 132 nya schemarader, fyra redan importerade Houston-rader och 13 Phoenix–Las Vegas-rader som återkommer i båda stadsavsnitten. Dubbletter matchas på nummer, ändpunkter, tider, dagar och datumförskjutning. Tulsa–Phoenix finns som N/S; returresorna har mellanlandning och importeras inte som direktflyg. Arizona/Mountain Time är UTC−7, Pacific Time UTC−8, Central Time UTC−6. Phoenix–Las Vegas landar fem minuter tidigare på destinationsklockan samma kalenderdag, med 55 minuters verklig tidtabellslängd. Denver använder historiska Stapleton, Las Vegas namnet McCarran. Fortsatt partiell bolagstäckning; övriga nätet, fullständiga genomgående tjänstekedjor och ändringsblad återstår. notes.en: The archive dates this Southwest system timetable to 12 January 1986. AirTimes lists the next edition on 18 March 1986; no printed expiry date or complete set of amendments has been verified. Printed pages 13–16 were visually checked. Red flight numbers designate Southwest; blue Muse Air rows are excluded. The page footers define N/S as nonstop and days 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. All 235 red N/S rows in the Dallas section are transcribed, including rows producing no movement in the window. Times are interpreted as local under timetable convention and the Central/Mountain Time difference; a separate all-times-local legend has not been found. Local departure dates are limited to 27 February–1 March, with interval overlap selecting visible movements. Scheduled service, not confirmed operation, identified aircraft or actual flight paths. The rest of the network, Muse Air, intermediate stops in through services and subsequent amendments remain unreviewed. V59: Houston Hobby section, pages 20–24, reviewed. 116 additional red N/S rows to/from 12 destinations transcribed; 45 Dallas rows were already imported in v58. Blue Muse Air rows and intermediate-stop/connecting itineraries excluded. PHX uses America/Phoenix, UTC−7; El Paso UTC−7 and the other new endpoints UTC−6 on the import dates. WN797 and WN717 arrive on the next local day; Sunday WN956/997 rows produce no movements in the window. Airline coverage remains partial: other network sections, Muse Air, complete physical through-service chains and amendments remain unreviewed. V60: Phoenix pages 44–46 and Las Vegas pages 27–29 visually reviewed. 149 red N/S source rows transcribed: 132 new schedules, four previously imported Houston rows and 13 Phoenix–Las Vegas rows repeated in both city sections. Duplicates match flight number, endpoints, times, operating days and arrival-day offset. Tulsa–Phoenix is N/S; the reverse itineraries have an intermediate stop and are not imported as nonstop. Arizona/Mountain Time UTC−7, Pacific Time UTC−8, Central Time UTC−6. Phoenix–Las Vegas arrives five minutes earlier on the destination clock on the same calendar day, with a 55-minute elapsed timetable duration. Denver uses historical Stapleton, Las Vegas the McCarran name. Airline coverage remains partial; other network sections, complete through-service chains and amendments remain unreviewed. V61: Albuquerque pages 2–4 and El Paso pages 17–20 visually reviewed. 170 red N/S source rows: 94 new schedules, 65 previously imported rows, one corrected previous row and ten Albuquerque–El Paso rows repeated in both city sections. Flight 797 El Paso–Houston arrival corrected from 00:25 to 00:05 next day; pages 18 and 22 agree. This was an import transcription error, not conflicting sources. Houston–El Paso 736 has one stop and is not nonstop. Kansas City denotes MCI rather than downtown MKC. Airline coverage remains partial; remaining network sections, through-service chains and amendments need review. V62: Los Angeles pages 30–32, Ontario 43–44, San Diego 51–53, San Francisco 53–54, Chicago Midway 10–11, Kansas City 25–27, St. Louis 55–56, Little Rock 29–30 and Tulsa 56–58 visually reviewed. 244 red N/S source rows: 66 new schedules, 129 previously imported rows, two corrected previous rows and 47 repeats between city sections. WN703 LAX–PHX corrected to days 15 and WN717 SAN–PHX to 12345 according to matching counterpart pages. Corrections affect only weekdays outside the import dates and notes, not previous movement times or counts. Chicago denotes Midway, separate from O’Hare. IAH–Tulsa 20 is N/S; no nonstop return inferred. Airline coverage remains partial; other network sections, complete through-service chains, Muse Air and amendments remain unreviewed. V63: remaining city sections Amarillo, Austin, Corpus Christi, Denver, Houston Intercontinental, Lubbock, Midland/Odessa, New Orleans, Oklahoma City, Harlingen and San Antonio reviewed for red N/S rows. 358 source rows: 16 new schedules, 324 previously imported, two corrected previous and 16 repeats of new schedules. 32 new movements; one erroneous previous Saturday WN736 SAT–ELP movement removed. WN906 LBB–ABQ and WN736 SAT–ELP corrected to days 123457 according to both endpoint sections. WN939 LBB–Austin 23:00–00:00 arrives on the next calendar day. This city sweep does not verify actual operation, complete through-service chains, Muse Air or later amendments. Next major research lead: Delta February timetable.
